period: Periodo beta (date live non ancora annunciate): 2026-12-01 ~ 2026-12-31
fixed_buff: I personaggi di apertura avranno PS max, ATT e DIF aumentano del 20%.

mechanics.season_effect_text: After the above characters join your party, Max HP, ATK, and DEF are increased by 20%.

instructions: Act 3 · Experimental Field Generator
A large and out-of-control Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering device.
During combat, it will channel ousia energy to unleash a Gravity Reduction Field. Characters within this field can jump significantly higher.
When the device is in this state, its Gravity Reduction Field will shut down if its core is annihilated by Pneuma attacks.
Act 6 · Veteran Arithmetic Enhancer Mek
During combat, it will channel ousia energy to unleash a Gravity Reduction Field.
Characters within this field can jump significantly higher. its core will be defended by a Geo Ward.
Destroy said Ward and annihilate its core using Pneuma attacks to shut its Gravity Reduction Field down.
Act 8 · Radiant Moongecko
A highly unique species among Radiant creatures, it can trap its enemies in a Radiant Cocoon during combat.
Quickly heal your HP to its maximum to escape from a Radiant Cocoon. Doing so will also reduce its Geo RES.
When it prepares to unleash Voidstep Reverberation, destroy the Moonstone Anchor it leaves behind to terminate the preparation of this Skill and deal massive DMG to it.
Act 10 · Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King
A Yumkasaurus that has experienced numerous impressive battles. It is not some abnormal mutant but has grown into its current shape due to its gluttony.
It will collect Flamegranates during combat and spit them out as bombs.
However, if you can use Pyro to ignite the Flamegranates before the Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King can swallow them, who knows what might happen...
Extra Act 1 · Keep Fighting
Keep fighting until the countdown ends. End the stage with at least one character left standing to successfully complete the challenge.
Each opponent you defeat will take time off the countdown.
Once the challenge begins, all party members will continuously lose small amounts of HP.
Extra Act 2 · Keep Fighting
Keep fighting until the countdown ends. End the stage with at least one character left standing to successfully complete the challenge.
Each opponent you defeat will take time off the countdown.
Once the challenge begins, Geo Bursts will periodically be set off, dealing Geo DMG to your active character.
